p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: Step 0 (gate): in WWOX-deficient versus isogenic corrected human neural cultures that contain microglia or CNS-macrophage-like cells (and, as a second system, Wwox-null mouse primary neuron-glia co-culture): nuclear NRF2 and KEAP1 protein, NQO1 enzyme activity and the transcripts NQO1, HMOX1, GCLM, SRXN1, ROS (roGFP/CellROX/MitoSOX) at baseline and after an oxidative challenge, and IL-6 and IL-1beta PROTEIN (and caspase-1 p20 if an inflammasome readout is used) after LPS (with and without ATP). Step 1: NFE2L2-dependence-controlled activation (KEAP1 knockdown; omaveloxolone; dimethyl fumarate and monomethyl fumarate as separate arms, never one row) with NFE2L2 knockdown or loss as the dependence control for every compound, in both genotypes, reading viability, lipid peroxidation, network activity (MEA), SOX2/NEUN fractions, and cytokine protein. Off-NRF2 readouts for the fumarates: NF-kB p65 nuclear translocation, HCAR2 dependence (HCAR2 knockdown or an antagonist) and GAPDH activity. Omaveloxolone is read over a concentration series that spans the low-nM NRF2-linked window and the hundreds-of-nM window in which IKK/NF-kB, JNK and growth effects were reported, reading NQO1 at each point (in-vitro facts of the source, not a dose recommendation), with free (unbound) exposure reported where serum is present. The system for step 0 also includes an astrocyte-containing challenged arm (LPS with and without ATP) and records the clone and batch of every sample, keeping both clones. Decided by: ROS, viability, network activity and cytokine protein. Not decided by: GFAP/IBA1 counts (held-out endpoints) or the six IT7 readout genes (guard IT7_READOUT6).
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: None for NRF2 pathway state, ROS, cytokine protein or inflammasome in a WWOX-deficient mammalian neural system. In the P47T cerebellum the hallmark set REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY is among the top enriched sets (PMID 36828035 Fig 9c; the direction of enrichment is not stated in the text read; a transcript set containing NRF2 targets, so it cannot separate raised ROS from a raised NRF2 response). Transcripts: Il6 up in null hippocampus (Tnf-a not significant), IL1B/TNF up in P47T cerebellum; rat glia lower; human organoid without cytokine expression. IT12 P2-P47T datum (no change of selection or priority): in the deposited P47T brain the NRF2 target transcripts Hmox1 and Srxn1 are modestly higher in all four regions (+0.3 to +0.7 log2), Nqo1 is mixed, Gclm and Txnrd1 flat; the target score tracks the astrocyte marker score across animals; the hallmark ROS set is a cerebellar finding (4 v 3) whose leading edge includes myelin genes. A transcript set containing NRF2 targets cannot separate raised ROS from a raised NRF2 response, and composition is not excluded.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Mouse transcripts at 2 weeks (null) and adult (P47T); the week-15 organoid has no microglia but has radial glia and astrocytes (an astrocyte increase by immunofluorescence is reported in the source paper), no stimulus and bulk poly-A RNA; IL6 and TNF were removed by the authors' own count filter, so no test exists: the deposit cannot test the microglial cytokine arm or any stimulated response and does not exclude an astrocytic cytokine route under challenge (whole-organoid GFAP transcript 0.88x against the astrocyte increase by immunofluorescence: transcript, protein and composition discordance); the NRF2-cytokine edge is from bone-marrow macrophages.

mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery
mission_dimensions.route_note: A mechanism experiment about whether NRF2 tone and ROS are insufficient (arm R) or a cytokine-expressing compartment exists and its Il6/Il1b output is harmful (arm C) in WWOX-deficient neural cells: partial benefit at best, and only if one arm is real. Not deep recovery. Track B: none.

disease_assertions.endpoint: qRT-PCR fold change, KO over WT (n 4 v 4)
disease_assertions.source: Hussain 2019 (PMID 30290271), Results 3.3, Fig 4E (publisher HTML PMC7104842 and repo XML)

context.genotype: Wwox KO versus Cre-positive WT littermate

disease_assertions.measured_result_note: 'We observed > 1.5 fold upregulation of both cytokines ( Il6 significant at p < .05)': significance is attached to Il6 only; the figure shows Il6 about 1.48x with one asterisk and Tnf-a about 1.85x with a large error bar and no mark. Il6 is the only significant cytokine; Tnf-a is a non-significant increase. This corrects the IT9 P1 'correction' that dropped the word Il6. The authors' abstract and Discussion state that both cytokines are increased; the method is a two-tailed unpaired Student's t, Gapdh, 2-week-old KO versus Cre-positive littermates, n 4 v 4; absence of a significance mark is not absence of an effect.

disease_assertions.target_id: IL1B and TNF transcripts, P47T cerebellum
disease_assertions.endpoint: qRT-PCR fold change, mutant over WT (n 6 v 6)
disease_assertions.locator: PMID36828035 full text (PMC10835625), Results; premises.tsv PR2
disease_assertions.measured_result_note: 'a significant >= 2-fold upregulation of mRNA of both cytokines (p-value < 0.05)' (transcript). Forebrain pathway enrichments (inflammatory response, TNFA signalling via NFkB, IL6-JAK-STAT3) are RNA-seq regulator inferences, not cytokine measurements. No NRF2/NFE2L2 string in the text. Verification (IT11 P2.3): the significant 2-fold claim is qPCR only, n 6 versus 6 (3 M + 3 F), unpaired Student's t, 18S, exact p not stated, age of the qPCR mice not stated; by the figure (read by eye, not digitised) IL1b is about 1.9x and TNF about 3.3x of the plotted means, overlap with WT is marginal for IL1b and absent for TNF; the cerebellar RNA-seq in the figure is 4 v 3 (Methods say 5 per group), so n 6 is not an RNA-seq n; the cerebellum is atrophic with Purkinje loss, so composition is not excluded. The best-supported cerebellar cytokine signal is TNF, the one NRF2 activation is predicted not to change.

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: At low nM concentrations RTA 408 activated NRF2 and lowered NO, Nos2, Ptgs2, Ccl2 and Ccl5 in interferon-gamma-stimulated RAW 264.7 cells; at hundreds of nM it inhibited NF-kB signalling (IkB-alpha phosphorylation, NF-kB luciferase), raised JNK phosphorylation and inhibited growth of wild-type and Keap1-null MEFs. The NRF2-siRNA control in that paper was done with bardoxolone methyl, not RTA 408; IL-6 and IL-1b were not measured. Direction UNKNOWN for the L01 endpoints: NRF2-dependent and NRF2-independent actions overlap in a concentration window. No NRF2-loss control for omaveloxolone on IL-6/IL-1b was found in the searches run (not found is not absent).

p4_card.identity: A pathway, not one compound: NRF2/KEAP1. Genetic arm primary; omaveloxolone (CHEMBL4303525, approved 2023, indication 16 y and older) and dimethyl fumarate (CHEMBL2107333; the NRF2-active ex vivo form) as two cysteine-reactive electrophiles, and monomethyl fumarate (CHEMBL589586) as a separate comparator, a different compound with an HCAR2 rationale whose NRF2 activity in neural cells is not shown (and is shown absent in one source, PMID 39684792). Omaveloxolone and dimethyl fumarate are both electrophiles, so agreement between them does not separate NRF2 dependence from electrophile-class actions; only NFE2L2 loss does. 'Second electrophile' is not a claim of independence. Voclosporin, PF-03758309 and the HMGB1-axis names are not carried (see candidates.tsv).
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WWOX-DEE only IF (arm R) ROS is raised and harmful in WWOX-deficient neural cells and NRF2 tone is not already maximal, OR (arm C) a cytokine-expressing compartment exists in WWOX-deficient brain and its Il6/Il1b output is harmful. Role of reactivity and of NRF2 tone: unknown; no arm is withdrawn. Nothing here is a treatment proposal.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NEW as a card axis (NRF2 absent from needs and cards; DL-MECH-153 holds only the G6PD/NFE2L2 co-occurrence). NEW compound name: omaveloxolone (named, not qualified, in IT9 P4c-D). Dimethyl fumarate and monomethyl fumarate are separate compounds; dimethyl fumarate is KNOWN: its generated chain was dropped in IT9 P4c-D and that drop is not reversed; this rationale is a different one and is declared.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: J01 (IL-1 axis, JAK-STAT, tetracyclines; protein-level agents with epilepsy exposure), DL-MECH-153, IT9 P4c-D P4CD-04.
p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN. Step 0 resolves, for any Q5 lever, whether a cytokine protein and a harmful compartment exist, and resolves the NRF2 tone and ROS question whatever the compound.
p4_card.mechanism: Targets: NFE2L2 (HGNC:7782), KEAP1 (HGNC:23177); direction wanted: raise NRF2 activity, only IF arm R or arm C holds. NRF2 lowers Il6 and Il1b but not Tnf in macrophages (PMID 27211851).

internal: seeds S084, S085, S086, S087 (S085 reason needs correction)

for: Il6 (null hippocampus, p<.05) and IL1B (P47T cerebellum) transcripts are up and NRF2 represses exactly those two (and not Tnf) in macrophages.
Neuronal Wwox knockdown raises H2O2 in Drosophila neurons; late-passage Wwox-null MEFs have raised ROS and an antioxidant (NAC) corrects senescence escape.
An NRF2 activator class member (CDDO-EA) delays spontaneous seizures after kainate SE in adult rat.
against: Tnf-a is not significant in the null hippocampus; the rat shows LOWER glia; the human organoid has no cytokine-expressing cells.
No NRF2 or ROS datum in any WWOX-deficient mammalian neural cell; human organoid NRF2 targets do not form a coherent signature (NFE2L2 0.75x, NQO1 0.73x).
The NRF2-cytokine edge is from bone-marrow macrophages under LPS, not microglia at baseline.
Early-passage redox-gene induction in Wwox-null MEFs suggests NRF2 tone may already be raised (ceiling).
Omaveloxolone: indication 16 y and older, perinatal rat neurobehavioural impairment, CYP3A4-inducer avoidance, transaminase rise, brain NRF2 induction modest in monkey.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: No datum from a WWOX-deficient neural cell for NRF2, ROS, cytokine protein or any compound; class precedents are adult acquired seizure models and macrophages.

p4_card.pharmacology: Omaveloxolone: NRF2 activator (ChEMBL mechanism row; no potency row), monkey brain content similar to plasma, 97% protein bound, CYP3A4 substrate, half-life 57 h (label). DMF: covalent KEAP1 modifier, micromolar cell EC50 (ChEMBL, IT9). MMF: the systemic and CSF moiety on the label and an HCAR2 agonist; NRF2 nuclear translocation was not seen with MMF in primary neurons where DMF gave it (PMID 39684792, one source); evidence is not transferred between the two. Omaveloxolone concentration window in vitro (PMID 25897966): low-nM NRF2-linked suppression, and NF-kB inhibition, JNK phosphorylation and growth inhibition at hundreds of nM; label protein binding 97 percent, so free exposure must be reported where serum is present (source facts, not a dose recommendation). Genetic arm: none.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: Omaveloxolone label: safety and effectiveness not established below 16 y; a paediatric phase 3 and a PK study from age 2 y are registered for Friedreich ataxia (NCT06953583, NCT06054893). Strong/moderate CYP3A4 inducers to be avoided. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card.

p4_card.predictions: None as scores. Qualitative, fixed before the experiment: if arm C is real, NRF2 activation lowers IL-6 and IL-1beta protein and leaves TNF unchanged in a microglia-containing system (TNF is the discriminator: 'Tnf unchanged' was observed only with genetic Keap1 deletion, PMID 27211851 Fig 1j; the NRF2-knockout control for pharmacological activation covers Nqo1, IL6, IL1b and IL1a only, so a TNF fall under a compound points to NF-kB/IKK-type action, documented for AIMs and for DMF independently of NRF2); if arm R is real, NRF2 activation lowers ROS and improves viability in KO cells more than in corrected cells.
p4_card.next_measurement: Step 0 then step 1 as in p4_fields.endpoint_pursued. Falsifiers: no ROS or NRF2-tone difference between KO and corrected cells and no cytokine protein above the assay floor (both arms fail); or activation changes nothing in KO cells while NFE2L2 knockdown also changes nothing (the axis is inert); or the effect of a compound survives NFE2L2 knockdown (off-target), or a TNF fall is seen under a compound (NF-kB/IKK-type action rather than NRF2-only action).
p4_card.value_added: Opens an axis independent of HIF/glycolysis and of antiseizure/NMDAR drugs; separates an engine arm (cytokine) from a redox arm; carries a corrected reading of the null-hippocampus cytokine datum; removes voclosporin (seizure label) and PF-03758309 (dominated) from the Q5 H_HARM list with the deciding datum for each.
p4_card.clinical_census: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-31 (this package): omaveloxolone x (epilepsy OR seizure OR DEE OR neurodevelopmental OR leukodystrophy) returned no studies; paediatric studies from age 2 y exist for Friedreich ataxia (NCT06953583, NCT06054893). A zero is no hits for the query string on that date, not proof that no study exists.
